rules.interaction_proxy: At least two active non-ego nodes and at least one permitted non-self neighbor-to-neighbor edge
rules.ego_only: No active non-ego trajectory node; scene and uncertain-risk memory are retained
rules.risk_context_present: At least one context-only B entity; not a claim of true visible obstacle or free space
